required: Validation precedes replay lookup; priority archived, missing document, disconnected destination, partner limit.
A matching replay record returns its existing state and reused=true, without insertion; its state need not be queued.
A valid new partner export selects partner-export; a non-partner selects documents.
Insertion occurs only after successful validation and absent/unmatched replay; result uses returned record.state, without assuming the queue contract forces queued.
displayName maps to displayName with trim; email to contactEmail with trim and lowercasing; locale to locale with underscores replaced by hyphens.
interval maps monthly->M and yearly->Y; trial omits billingCycle.
vatId and timezone have null target declarations and are absent from the constructed payload.
No external remote schema validation/acceptance requirements are established by this code; mark this limit rather than inventing mappings.
failures: Overstated absence outside the included code

hypothesis_gate.quality: All required facts and source support retained on both cases.
hypothesis_gate.efficiency: Evaluate model responses, fresh/cached input, output, reasoning-token counts separately. Fewer final words alone does not support a thinking reduction claim.
hypothesis_gate.adoption: Do not ship an answer contract unless the paired observed evidence supports its claimed benefit without a quality regression. n=1 supports a narrow hypothesis only.
hypothesis_gate.claude: Codex-only candidate: one unchanged Claude control per case, not two repeated byte-identical conditions.
hypothesis_gate.privacy: No expected answers, grading, prior transcripts or private reasoning exposed to actors.
